_comment: Context for translators. Keys must match en.json. Tone: plain, short, no ERP jargon (design system README, Content).
appTeacher: App name shown under the logo and on the home screen. Keep the brand name OruSchools in Latin letters.
appStaff: App name for non-teaching staff (office, lab assistants, support).
appParent: App name for parents and students.
appPlatform: Name of the platform administration site (for the SaaS owner).
appWebsite: Title of the public website (browser tab). The tagline 'Schools. People. Progress.' is fixed brand copy: translate it only with approval (brand guidelines).
scaffoldNotice: Temporary placeholder text on unfinished screens. Not shown to schools in production.
greetingMorning: Home screen greeting before 12:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingAfternoon: Home screen greeting 12:00-17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingEvening: Home screen greeting after 17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
actionUploadNow: Button that sends saved offline work immediately.
actionTakeAttendance: Primary button on the teacher home screen.
actionMarkAllPresent: Button that marks every student present; the teacher then changes only the exceptions.
actionSubmitAttendance: Primary button that submits the class attendance.
syncSynced: Sync status: all work is on the server.
syncSavedOnDevice: Sync status: work is saved on this phone and will upload when online.
syncChangesPending: Sync status: number of changes waiting to upload. Use the language's correct plural forms.
syncFailed: Sync status: the upload did not work.
statusLate: Attendance status: arrived after the bell.
statusMedical: Attendance status: absent for a medical reason.
statusHalfDay: Attendance status: present for half the day.
errorServerUnreachable: Error message. Reassures the user that nothing is lost; never blames them.
